en.title: Minimum Insertions to Balance Ordinary Parentheses
en.description:
Only insertions of left and right parentheses are allowed, to turn the string into an ordinary valid parenthesis string. Each left parenthesis is matched with one right parenthesis. Find the minimum number of insertions.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a string of only left and right parentheses, of length 1..100000.
en.explanation: The examples give 2, 1 and 4 respectively. The 4 in the original second example actually belongs to a different string; this site corrects it according to the statement body and the explanation.
hints: Maintain the number of unmatched left parentheses; when a right parenthesis appears, cancel it against a left one if there is one, otherwise insert a left one; finally add right parentheses for the remaining left ones.
